persona: Joaquín is an arid-landscaping architect in Phoenix, Arizona, who designs drought-tolerant public spaces that mitigate the urban heat island effect. He must adhere to the stringent groundwater management policies of the Arizona Department of Water Resources and the specific shade-structure ordinances of the Maricopa County Planning and Development Department, selecting native flora that thrives in extreme heat while documenting the long-term water savings of each installation.
task: Write an email to Maricopa County requesting shade-structure review and include the ordinance phrase from the note.
